f_ref() =>
    bool manual=sessionMode=="Manual"
    bool inSess=manual or india ? not na(time(timeframe.period,sess,tz)) : true
    int resetMinutes=crypto ? cryptoHour*60+cryptoMinute : fxHour*60+fxMinute
    int key=manual or india ? time("D") : int(math.floor((time+19800000-resetMinutes*60000)/86400000))
    bool gap=openingMode=="Auto gap + IST fallback" and not crypto and not india and time-time_close[1]>=openingGap*60000
    bool first=inSess and (not inSess[1] or key!=key[1] or gap)
    var float hi=na
    var float lo=na
    var int sessionStart=na
    var int lockedTime=na
    if first
        hi:=na
        lo:=na
        lockedTime:=na
        sessionStart:=time
    bool wanted=greenReference ? close>open : close<open
    if inSess and not first and na(hi) and wanted
        hi:=high
        lo:=low
        lockedTime:=time
    [hi,lo,sessionStart,lockedTime]

// Target reveal and first-touch times are retained. Cross-market parity remains under review.
type TargetSession
    float hi
    float lo
    int key
    int finish
    array<int> revealUp
    array<int> revealDown
    array<int> hitUp
    array<int> hitDown
var array<TargetSession> targetSessions=array.new<TargetSession>()
var array<line> targetLines=array.new<line>()
var array<box> targetBoxes=array.new<box>()
var array<label> targetText=array.new<label>()
bool newSession=active and (array.size(targetSessions)==0 or array.last(targetSessions).key!=k5)
if newSession
    array.push(targetSessions,TargetSession.new(a,b,k5,time,array.new<int>(20,na),array.new<int>(20,na),array.new<int>(20,na),array.new<int>(20,na)))
    if array.size(targetSessions)>historyInput
        array.shift(targetSessions)
if active and array.size(targetSessions)>0
    TargetSession rec=array.last(targetSessions)
    rec.finish:=time
    float span=rec.hi-rec.lo
    if span>0
        for n=1 to 20
            float up=rec.hi+n*span
            float down=rec.lo-n*span
            if na(array.get(rec.hitUp,n-1)) and high>=up
                array.set(rec.hitUp,n-1,time)
            if na(array.get(rec.hitDown,n-1)) and low<=down
                array.set(rec.hitDown,n-1,time)
            int upAhead=math.max(1,int(math.floor((close-rec.hi)/span))+forward)
            int dnAhead=math.max(1,int(math.floor((rec.lo-close)/span))+forward)
            if (newSession or barstate.isconfirmed) and n<=upAhead and na(array.get(rec.revealUp,n-1))
                array.set(rec.revealUp,n-1,time)
            if (newSession or barstate.isconfirmed) and n<=dnAhead and na(array.get(rec.revealDown,n-1))
                array.set(rec.revealDown,n-1,time)
f_targetSegment(int left,int right,float price,float span,color col) =>
    if right>=left
        array.push(targetLines,line.new(left,price,right,price,xloc=xloc.bar_time,color=col,width=targetWidth, force_overlay=true))
        while array.size(targetLines) > 90
            line.delete(array.shift(targetLines))
        if targetBands
            array.push(targetBoxes,box.new(left,price+span*.06,right,price-span*.06,xloc=xloc.bar_time,border_color=color.new(col,90),border_width=bandWidth,bgcolor=color.new(col,targetTransparency), force_overlay=true))
            while array.size(targetBoxes) > 180
                box.delete(array.shift(targetBoxes))
f_renderTarget(TargetSession rec,int n,bool upper) =>
    float span=rec.hi-rec.lo
    float price=upper ? rec.hi+n*span : rec.lo-n*span
    int reveal=targetMode=="ALL" ? rec.key : upper ? array.get(rec.revealUp,n-1) : array.get(rec.revealDown,n-1)
    int hit=upper ? array.get(rec.hitUp,n-1) : array.get(rec.hitDown,n-1)
    color reached=upper ? upperColor : lowerColor
    if not na(reveal)
        if na(hit) or hit>rec.finish
            f_targetSegment(reveal,rec.finish,price,span,pendingColor)
        else
            if hit>reveal
                f_targetSegment(reveal,hit,price,span,pendingColor)
            f_targetSegment(math.max(reveal,hit),rec.finish,price,span,reached)
        if targetLabels and n>10
            array.push(targetText,label.new(rec.finish,price,"T"+str.tostring(n)+" "+str.tostring(price,"#.##"),xloc=xloc.bar_time,style=label.style_label_left,color=color.new(color.black,100),textcolor=na(hit) ? pendingColor : reached,size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true))
if barstate.islast
    for item in targetLines
        line.delete(item)
    array.clear(targetLines)
    for item in targetBoxes
        box.delete(item)
    array.clear(targetBoxes)
    for item in targetText
        label.delete(item)
    array.clear(targetText)
    if showTargets and targetMode!="OFF" and array.size(targetSessions)>0
        for rec in targetSessions
            for n=1 to targetCount
                f_renderTarget(rec,n,true)
                if bothDirections
                    f_renderTarget(rec,n,false)

// Shared TradingView object budget: keep newest targetLines.
if barstate.islast
    while array.size(targetLines) > 90
        line.delete(array.shift(targetLines))

// Shared TradingView object budget: keep newest targetBoxes.
if barstate.islast
    while array.size(targetBoxes) > 180
        box.delete(array.shift(targetBoxes))

string gWindow="05 — INDEPENDENT IST CANDLE WINDOWS"
bool mark1230=input.bool(true,"Mark 12:30-13:00 IST",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
bool mark1730=input.bool(true,"Mark 17:30-18:00 IST",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
color color1230=input.color(color.rgb(0,175,230),"12:30 color",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
color color1730=input.color(color.rgb(165,65,240),"17:30 color",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
int windowTransparency=input.int(78,"Candle box transparency",minval=0,maxval=100,group=gWindow,display=display.none)
bool windowInternal=input.bool(true,"Show 44/50/56% inside candle",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
bool windowExtend=input.bool(true,"Extend 44/50/56% candleSpan levels",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
bool windowHL=input.bool(false,"Also extend High/Low",group=gWindow,display=display.none)
int windowKeep=input.int(8,"Keep last N windows",minval=1,maxval=20,group=gWindow,display=display.none)
string gCut="05A — MARKER NEXT RED BAR CUTOFF"
string markerTF=input.timeframe("30","Red Bar timeframe",group=gCut,display=display.none)
int markerHour=input.int(2,"Session start IST hour (BTC 02:30)",minval=0,maxval=23,group=gCut,display=display.none)
int markerMinute=input.int(30,"Session start IST minute",options=[0,15,30,45],group=gCut,display=display.none)
bool markerSkip=input.bool(true,"Ignore first session candle",group=gCut,display=display.none)
f_window(int hh,int mm) =>
    bool selected=hour(time,"Asia/Kolkata")==hh and minute(time,"Asia/Kolkata")==mm
    var float wh=na
    var float wl=na
    var int wt=na
    var int we=na
    if selected
        wh:=high
        wl:=low
        wt:=time
        we:=time_close
    [wh,wl,wt,we]
f_markerCutoff() =>
    int key=int(math.floor((time+19800000-(markerHour*60+markerMinute)*60000)/86400000))
    bool first=key!=key[1]
    var int locked=na
    var int lastKey=na
    if first
        lastKey:=na
    if close<open and (not markerSkip or not first) and na(lastKey)
        locked:=time_close
        lastKey:=key
    locked
[w1h,w1l,w1t,w1e]=request.security(symbol,"30",f_window(12,30),lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
[w2h,w2l,w2t,w2e]=request.security(symbol,"30",f_window(17,30),lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
int markerCut=request.security(symbol,markerTF,f_markerCutoff(),lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
type WindowRecord
    float hi
    float lo
    int start
    int finish
    int cutoff
    int kind
var array<WindowRecord> windows=array.new<WindowRecord>()
var array<box> windowBoxes=array.new<box>()
var array<line> windowLines=array.new<line>()
if not na(w1t) and (na(w1t[1]) or w1t!=w1t[1])
    array.push(windows,WindowRecord.new(w1h,w1l,w1t,w1e,na,1))
if not na(w2t) and (na(w2t[1]) or w2t!=w2t[1])
    array.push(windows,WindowRecord.new(w2h,w2l,w2t,w2e,na,2))
if array.size(windows)>windowKeep
    array.shift(windows)
for rec in windows
    if na(rec.cutoff) and not na(markerCut) and markerCut>rec.finish
        rec.cutoff:=markerCut
if barstate.islast
    for item in windowBoxes
        box.delete(item)
    array.clear(windowBoxes)
    for item in windowLines
        line.delete(item)
    array.clear(windowLines)
    for rec in windows
        bool enabled=rec.kind==1 ? mark1230 : mark1730
        if enabled
            color col=rec.kind==1 ? color1230 : color1730
            array.push(windowBoxes,box.new(rec.start,rec.hi,rec.finish,rec.lo,xloc=xloc.bar_time,border_color=col,border_width=2,bgcolor=color.new(col,windowTransparency), force_overlay=true))
            for p in array.from(.44,.50,.56)
                float price=rec.lo+(rec.hi-rec.lo)*p
                if windowInternal
                    array.push(windowLines,line.new(rec.start,price,rec.finish,price,xloc=xloc.bar_time,color=f_fibTint(col,p),width=p==.50 ? 2 : 1,style=line.style_solid, force_overlay=true))
                    while array.size(windowLines) > 60
                        line.delete(array.shift(windowLines))
                if windowExtend
                    int right=na(rec.cutoff) ? time : rec.cutoff
                    array.push(windowLines,line.new(rec.finish,price,right,price,xloc=xloc.bar_time,color=f_fibTint(col,p),width=p==.50 ? 2 : 1,style=line.style_solid, force_overlay=true))
                    while array.size(windowLines) > 60
                        line.delete(array.shift(windowLines))
            if windowHL
                int right=na(rec.cutoff) ? time : rec.cutoff
                array.push(windowLines,line.new(rec.finish,rec.hi,right,rec.hi,xloc=xloc.bar_time,color=col,style=line.style_dotted, force_overlay=true))
                while array.size(windowLines) > 60
                    line.delete(array.shift(windowLines))
                array.push(windowLines,line.new(rec.finish,rec.lo,right,rec.lo,xloc=xloc.bar_time,color=col,style=line.style_dotted, force_overlay=true))
                while array.size(windowLines) > 60
                    line.delete(array.shift(windowLines))

// Shared TradingView object budget: keep newest windowLines.
if barstate.islast
    while array.size(windowLines) > 60
        line.delete(array.shift(windowLines))

// Observational dashboard inference. These proxies are not the private engine formulas.
bool showDashboard=input.bool(true,"Show dashboard",group="02 — CHART VISIBILITY",display=display.none)
string dashboardMode=input.string("Compact","Dashboard mode",options=["Compact","Detailed","Off"],group="00 | DASHBOARD",display=display.none)
string dashboardPosition=input.string("Top Right","Dashboard position",options=["Top Right","Top Left","Bottom Right","Bottom Left"],group="00 | DASHBOARD",display=display.none)
string gInference="INFERRED ENGINE SETTINGS"
bool inferDashboard=input.bool(true,"Use inferred dashboard states",group=gInference,tooltip="Approximate states calibrated against exported observations. This does not establish exact reference-engine parity.",display=display.none)
int inferredPeriod=input.int(123,"Sector Pulse Gaussian period (inferred)",minval=5,maxval=500,group=gInference,display=display.none)
int inferredATR=input.int(14,"Trend proxy ATR length",minval=1,group=gInference,display=display.none)
float inferredFactor=input.float(5.7,"Trend proxy factor (inferred)",minval=0.1,step=0.1,group=gInference,display=display.none)
float inferredBeta=(1-math.cos(2*math.pi/inferredPeriod))/(math.pow(2.0,1.0/3.0)-1)
float inferredAlpha=-inferredBeta+math.sqrt(inferredBeta*inferredBeta+2*inferredBeta)
var float inferredG1=na

        array.push(sc_band.sc_layers, box.new(sc_started, sc_lo+(sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_b/100, sc_started, sc_lo+(sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_a/100, xloc=xloc.bar_time, border_color=na, bgcolor=sc_shade, force_overlay=true))
    array.push(sc_bandHistory, sc_band)
    sc_band

sc_finishSet(array<line> sc_active) =>
    if array.size(sc_active) > 0
        for sc_ln in sc_active
            line.set_x2(sc_ln, sc_confirmedFinalNow ? sc_sourceClose : time)
    array.clear(sc_active)

sc_drawSet(float sc_hi, float sc_lo, int sc_opened, int sc_closed, bool sc_complete, array<line> sc_history, array<line> sc_active) =>
    array<float> sc_prices = array.from(sc_hi, sc_lo, sc_lo + (sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_p1/100, sc_lo + (sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_p2/100, sc_lo + (sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_p3/100)
    array<color> sc_colors = array.from(sc_edge, sc_edge, sc_c1, sc_c2, sc_c3)
    for sc_i = 0 to 4
        color sc_col = sc_i < 2 ? (sc_complete ? color.new(array.get(sc_colors, sc_i),45) : array.get(sc_colors, sc_i)) : f_fibTint(array.get(sc_colors,sc_i),sc_i == 3 ? 0.50 : 0.44)
        int sc_publishedAt = sc_confirmedFinalNow ? sc_closed : time
        int sc_displayedUntil = barstate.islast ? sc_chartEnd + int(timeframe.in_seconds()*1000)*sc_labelOffset : sc_chartEnd
        line sc_ln = line.new(sc_publishedAt, array.get(sc_prices, sc_i), sc_displayedUntil, array.get(sc_prices, sc_i), xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=sc_col, width=sc_i == 3 ? 2 : 1, style=sc_i == 3 ? line.style_solid : sc_complete ? line.style_dashed : line.style_solid, force_overlay=true)
        array.push(sc_history, sc_ln)
        array.push(sc_active, sc_ln)
    if sc_showSourceMarkers
        string sc_identity = sc_complete ? "Complete " + sc_refTf + "m reference candle" : "Shadow Candle"
        string sc_labelText = sc_identity + "\n" + str.format_time(sc_opened, "dd MMM HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + " → " + str.format_time(sc_closed, "dd MMM HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "\nH " + str.tostring(sc_hi, "#.##") + "  L " + str.tostring(sc_lo, "#.##") + "\n" + str.tostring(sc_p1, "#.##") + "% " + str.tostring(sc_lo + (sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_p1/100, "#.##") + " | " + str.tostring(sc_p2, "#.##") + "% " + str.tostring(sc_lo + (sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_p2/100, "#.##") + " | " + str.tostring(sc_p3, "#.##") + "% " + str.tostring(sc_lo + (sc_hi-sc_lo)*sc_p3/100, "#.##")
        array.push(sc_labels, label.new(time, sc_lo, "", xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_circle, color=sc_complete ? color.new(color.purple, 25) : color.new(color.rgb(30, 41, 59), 15), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_labelText, force_overlay=true))
    while array.size(sc_history) > sc_keep * 5
        line.delete(array.shift(sc_history))
    while array.size(sc_labels) > sc_keep * (sc_showFinal and sc_showFull ? 2 : 1)
        label.delete(array.shift(sc_labels))

sc_scDetails(sc_SCReference sc_sc) =>
    "Historical Shadow Candle\n" + str.format_time(sc_sc.sc_opened, "dd MMM yyyy HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "–" + str.format_time(sc_sc.sc_closed, "HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "\nHigh " + str.tostring(sc_sc.sc_hi, "#.##") + " · Low " + str.tostring(sc_sc.sc_lo, "#.##")

sc_freezeSc(sc_SCReference sc_sc, int sc_ended) =>
    if not na(sc_sc.sc_tag)
        label.set_x(sc_sc.sc_tag, chart.is_renko ? bar_index : sc_ended)
    if not na(sc_sc.sc_leader)
        line.set_x2(sc_sc.sc_leader, sc_ended)

sc_revealSc(sc_SCReference sc_sc, int sc_direction, int sc_started) =>
    sc_sc.sc_approach := sc_direction
    sc_sc.sc_anchorAt := sc_started
    sc_sc.sc_broken := false
    sc_sc.sc_brokenAt := na
    sc_sc.sc_brokenDirection := 0
    int sc_future = sc_started + int(timeframe.in_seconds()*1000)*sc_labelOffset
    color sc_tint = sc_direction > 0 ? sc_bullColor : sc_bearColor
    string sc_caption = "SC " + (sc_direction > 0 ? "↑ " : "↓ ") + str.format_time(sc_sc.sc_opened, "dd MMM", syminfo.timezone)
    string sc_details = sc_scDetails(sc_sc) + "\nRevealed after confirmed " + (sc_direction > 0 ? "upward" : "downward") + " break at " + str.format_time(sc_started, "dd MMM HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "\nNearest archived range still beyond the breakout close; original SC retained."
    if sc_showLabels
        if na(sc_sc.sc_tag)
            if chart.is_renko
                sc_sc.sc_tag := label.new(chart.is_renko ? bar_index + sc_labelOffset : sc_future, sc_sc.sc_lo, sc_caption, xloc=xloc.bar_index, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(sc_tint, 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_details, force_overlay=true)
            else
                sc_sc.sc_tag := label.new(chart.is_renko ? bar_index + sc_labelOffset : sc_future, sc_sc.sc_lo, sc_caption, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(sc_tint, 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_details, force_overlay=true)
        else
            label.set_xy(sc_sc.sc_tag, chart.is_renko ? bar_index + sc_labelOffset : sc_future, sc_sc.sc_lo)
            label.set_text(sc_sc.sc_tag, sc_caption)
            label.set_color(sc_sc.sc_tag, color.new(sc_tint, 10))
            label.set_tooltip(sc_sc.sc_tag, sc_details)
    if na(sc_sc.sc_leader)
        sc_sc.sc_leader := line.new(sc_started, sc_sc.sc_lo, sc_future, sc_sc.sc_lo, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=sc_tint, style=line.style_dotted, force_overlay=true)
    else
        line.set_xy1(sc_sc.sc_leader, sc_started, sc_sc.sc_lo)
        line.set_xy2(sc_sc.sc_leader, sc_future, sc_sc.sc_lo)
        line.set_color(sc_sc.sc_leader, sc_tint)
    sc_sc

// Advance SC targets only from completed native 5m events on every chart.
sc_scAdvance(sc_SCReference sc_initialSc, float sc_sourcePrice, int sc_ended) =>
    sc_SCReference sc_currentSc = sc_initialSc
    if sc_showFinal and not na(sc_currentSc) and not na(sc_ended) and sc_ended > sc_currentSc.sc_anchorAt
        if not sc_currentSc.sc_broken
            int sc_direction = sc_currentSc.sc_approach >= 0 and sc_sourcePrice > sc_currentSc.sc_hi ? 1 : sc_currentSc.sc_approach <= 0 and sc_sourcePrice < sc_currentSc.sc_lo ? -1 : 0
            if sc_direction != 0
                sc_currentSc.sc_broken := true
                sc_currentSc.sc_brokenAt := sc_ended
                sc_currentSc.sc_brokenDirection := sc_direction
                sc_freezeSc(sc_currentSc, sc_ended)
                if not na(sc_currentSc.sc_tag)
                    label.set_tooltip(sc_currentSc.sc_tag, sc_scDetails(sc_currentSc) + "\nBroken " + (sc_direction > 0 ? "above" : "below") + " on confirmed 5m close " + str.format_time(sc_ended, "dd MMM HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "\nThis original SC is retained.")
                sc_SCReference sc_nextSc = na
                float sc_nearest = na
                for sc_candidate in sc_scArchive
                    bool sc_unvisited = na(sc_candidate.sc_visitedChain) or sc_candidate.sc_visitedChain != sc_scChainKey
                    bool sc_older = sc_candidate.sc_opened < sc_scChainKey
                    bool sc_ahead = sc_direction > 0 ? sc_candidate.sc_lo > sc_sourcePrice : sc_candidate.sc_hi < sc_sourcePrice
                    if sc_older and sc_unvisited and sc_ahead
                        float sc_distance = sc_direction > 0 ? sc_candidate.sc_lo-sc_sourcePrice : sc_sourcePrice-sc_candidate.sc_hi
                        if na(sc_nearest) or sc_distance <= sc_nearest
                            sc_nearest := sc_distance
                            sc_nextSc := sc_candidate
                if not na(sc_nextSc)
                    sc_nextSc.sc_visitedChain := sc_scChainKey
                    sc_revealSc(sc_nextSc, sc_direction, sc_ended)
                    sc_currentSc := sc_nextSc
    sc_currentSc

if sc_finalBar and (na(sc_lastSource) or sc_sourceOpen != sc_lastSource)
    sc_SCReference sc_freshSc = na
    sc_lastSource := sc_sourceOpen
    sc_missingFinal := not sc_validFinal
    sc_lockedClose := sc_sourceClose
    sc_lockedScheduled := sc_scheduledClose
    sc_lockedHigh := sc_validFinal ? sc_h : na
    sc_lockedLow := sc_validFinal ? sc_l : na
    sc_lockedFullHigh := sc_fullHigh
    sc_lockedFullLow := sc_fullLow
    sc_lockedFullOpen := sc_fullOpen
    sc_lockedFullClose := sc_fullClose
    if not na(sc_currentBand)
        sc_endBand(sc_currentBand, sc_confirmedFinalNow ? sc_sourceClose : time)
    sc_currentBand := na
    sc_regime := 0
    array.push(sc_sessionHistory, sc_sourceOpen)
    while array.size(sc_sessionHistory) > sc_keep
        array.shift(sc_sessionHistory)
    while array.size(sc_bandHistory) > 0
        sc_ZoneBand sc_oldest = array.get(sc_bandHistory, 0)
        if sc_oldest.sourceKey < array.get(sc_sessionHistory, 0)
            sc_deleteBand(array.shift(sc_bandHistory))
        else
            break
    // Retire the active pointer without deleting its retained source label.
    if not na(sc_activeSc)
        sc_freezeSc(sc_activeSc, sc_confirmedFinalNow ? sc_sourceClose : time)
    sc_rangeTag := na
    sc_tagLeader := na
    sc_activeSc := na
    if sc_validFinal
        sc_scChainKey := sc_sourceOpen
        sc_freshSc := sc_SCReference.new(sc_sourceOpen, sc_sourceClose, sc_h, sc_l, na, na, sc_scChainKey, 0, false, sc_sourceClose, na, 0)
        array.push(sc_scArchive, sc_freshSc)
        sc_activeSc := sc_freshSc
    while array.size(sc_scArchive) > sc_keep
        sc_SCReference sc_expired = array.shift(sc_scArchive)
        if not na(sc_expired.sc_tag)
            label.delete(sc_expired.sc_tag)
        if not na(sc_expired.sc_leader)
            line.delete(sc_expired.sc_leader)
    sc_finishSet(sc_activeFinal)
    sc_finishSet(sc_activeFull)
    // Confirmed source bounds, drawn back over ONLY its constituent chart candles.
    if sc_showSourceBoxes and sc_validFinal and timeframe.in_seconds() <= timeframe.in_seconds(sc_refTf)
        // Native reference OHLC equals the blended constituent-candle group.
        // Freeze its OWN direction; later breakout regimes never recolor this source box.
        color sc_sourceTint = sc_sourceOhlcClose > sc_sourceOhlcOpen ? sc_bullColor : sc_sourceOhlcClose < sc_sourceOhlcOpen ? sc_bearColor : sc_sourceBoxColor
        array.push(sc_sourceBoxes, box.new(sc_sourceOpen, sc_h, sc_sourceClose, sc_l, xloc=xloc.bar_time, border_color=color.new(sc_sourceTint, 35), border_width=1, bgcolor=color.new(sc_sourceTint, sc_sourceBoxTransparency), force_overlay=true))
        while array.size(sc_sourceBoxes) > sc_keep
            box.delete(array.shift(sc_sourceBoxes))
    if sc_showFinal and sc_validFinal
        sc_drawSet(sc_h, sc_l, sc_sourceOpen, sc_sourceClose, false, sc_finalLines, sc_activeFinal)
        if sc_showGradient
            sc_currentBand := sc_makeBand(sc_confirmedFinalNow ? sc_sourceClose : time, sc_sourceOpen, sc_h, sc_l, 0)
        if sc_showLabels
            string sc_details = "Shadow Candle\n" + str.format_time(sc_sourceOpen, "dd MMM HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "–" + str.format_time(sc_sourceClose, "HH:mm", syminfo.timezone) + "\nBlended O " + str.tostring(sc_sourceOhlcOpen, "#.##") + " · C " + str.tostring(sc_sourceOhlcClose, "#.##") + "\nHigh " + str.tostring(sc_h, "#.##") + " · Low " + str.tostring(sc_l, "#.##")
            if chart.is_renko
                sc_rangeTag := label.new(chart.is_renko ? bar_index : sc_chartEnd, sc_l, "SC", xloc=xloc.bar_index, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(color.rgb(30, 41, 59), 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_details, force_overlay=true)
            else
                sc_rangeTag := label.new(chart.is_renko ? bar_index : sc_chartEnd, sc_l, "SC", xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(color.rgb(30, 41, 59), 10), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_details, force_overlay=true)
            sc_tagLeader := line.new(sc_chartEnd, sc_l, sc_chartEnd, sc_l, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=sc_edge, style=line.style_dotted, force_overlay=true)
            sc_freshSc.sc_tag := sc_rangeTag
            sc_freshSc.sc_leader := sc_tagLeader
            label.set_text(sc_rangeTag, "SC · " + str.format_time(sc_sourceOpen, "dd MMM", syminfo.timezone))
    if sc_showFull and not na(sc_fullHigh)
        sc_drawSet(sc_fullHigh, sc_fullLow, sc_fullOpen, sc_fullClose, true, sc_fullLines, sc_activeFull)
// Use chart-bar confirmation outside request.security. Forming ticks cannot change regime.
// A transition begins at sc_chartEnd; the earlier portion of this bar/session is untouched.
if not na(sc_currentBand)
    sc_endBand(sc_currentBand, sc_chartEnd)
if sc_showFinal and not sc_missingFinal and not na(sc_lockedHigh) and barstate.isconfirmed
    int sc_nextRegime = close > sc_lockedHigh ? 1 : close < sc_lockedLow ? -1 : 0
    if sc_nextRegime != sc_regime
        if not na(sc_currentBand)
            sc_endBand(sc_currentBand, sc_chartEnd)
        sc_regime := sc_nextRegime
        if sc_showGradient
            sc_currentBand := sc_makeBand(sc_chartEnd, sc_lastSource, sc_lockedHigh, sc_lockedLow, sc_regime)
// Only the current SC advances. Earlier SC labels/levels remain frozen.
if not na(sc_activeSc) and sc_showFinal
    if not sc_activeSc.sc_broken
        int sc_labelTime = sc_chartEnd + int(timeframe.in_seconds()*1000)*sc_labelOffset
        if sc_showLabels and not na(sc_activeSc.sc_tag)
            label.set_xy(sc_activeSc.sc_tag, chart.is_renko ? bar_index + sc_labelOffset : sc_labelTime, sc_activeSc.sc_lo)
        if not na(sc_activeSc.sc_leader)
            line.set_xy1(sc_activeSc.sc_leader, sc_activeSc.sc_anchorAt, sc_activeSc.sc_lo)
            line.set_xy2(sc_activeSc.sc_leader, sc_labelTime, sc_activeSc.sc_lo)
        if sc_activeSc.sc_approach == 0
            color sc_tint = sc_regime == 0 ? color.rgb(30, 41, 59) : sc_zoneColor(sc_regime)
            if not na(sc_activeSc.sc_tag)
                label.set_color(sc_activeSc.sc_tag, color.new(sc_tint, 10))
            if not na(sc_activeSc.sc_leader)
                line.set_color(sc_activeSc.sc_leader, sc_regime == 0 ? sc_edge : sc_tint)
if array.size(sc_activeFinal) > 0
    for sc_ln in sc_activeFinal
        line.set_x2(sc_ln, barstate.islast ? sc_chartEnd + int(timeframe.in_seconds()*1000)*sc_labelOffset : sc_chartEnd)
if array.size(sc_activeFull) > 0
    for sc_ln in sc_activeFull
        line.set_x2(sc_ln, barstate.islast ? sc_chartEnd + int(timeframe.in_seconds()*1000)*sc_labelOffset : sc_chartEnd)


// Confirmed prior exchange candles. Current-period time is calendar metadata only.
// Daily means previous TRADING session, weekly/monthly mean completed exchange periods.
[sc_pdh, sc_pdl, sc_daySource, sc_dayStart] = request.security(sc_requestTicker, "1D", [high[1], low[1], time[1], time], gaps=barmerge.gaps_off, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
[sc_pwh, sc_pwl, sc_weekSource, sc_weekStart] = request.security(sc_requestTicker, "1W", [high[1], low[1], time[1], time], gaps=barmerge.gaps_off, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
[sc_pmh, sc_pml, sc_monthSource, sc_monthStart] = request.security(sc_requestTicker, "1M", [high[1], low[1], time[1], time], gaps=barmerge.gaps_off, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
var array<line> sc_periodLines = array.new<line>(6, na)
var array<label> sc_periodTags = array.new<label>(6, na)
array<float> sc_periodPrices = array.from(sc_pdh, sc_pdl, sc_pwh, sc_pwl, sc_pmh, sc_pml)
array<int> sc_periodStarts = array.from(sc_dayStart, sc_dayStart, sc_weekStart, sc_weekStart, sc_monthStart, sc_monthStart)
array<int> sc_sourceStarts = array.from(sc_daySource, sc_daySource, sc_weekSource, sc_weekSource, sc_monthSource, sc_monthSource)
array<string> sc_periodNames = array.from("PDH", "PDL", "PWH", "PWL", "PMH", "PML")
array<color> sc_periodColors = array.from(sc_dayColor, sc_dayColor, sc_weekColor, sc_weekColor, sc_monthColor, sc_monthColor)
array<bool> sc_enabledPeriods = array.from(sc_showPreviousDay, sc_showPreviousDay, sc_showPreviousWeek, sc_showPreviousWeek, sc_showPreviousMonth, sc_showPreviousMonth)
// Separate nearby labels horizontally; line/label price anchors are NEVER displaced.
float sc_upperPrice = na
float sc_lowerPrice = na
for sc_i = 0 to 5
    float sc_price = array.get(sc_periodPrices, sc_i)
    if array.get(sc_enabledPeriods, sc_i) and not na(sc_price)
        sc_upperPrice := na(sc_upperPrice) ? sc_price : math.max(sc_upperPrice, sc_price)
        sc_lowerPrice := na(sc_lowerPrice) ? sc_price : math.min(sc_lowerPrice, sc_price)
float sc_proximity = math.max((sc_upperPrice-sc_lowerPrice)*0.04, syminfo.mintick*10)
array<int> sc_lanes = array.new<int>(6, 0)
for sc_i = 0 to 5
    float sc_price = array.get(sc_periodPrices, sc_i)
    if array.get(sc_enabledPeriods, sc_i) and not na(sc_price)
        int sc_lane = sc_showLabels and sc_showFinal and not na(sc_lockedLow) and math.abs(sc_price-sc_lockedLow) < sc_proximity ? 1 : 0
        if sc_i > 0
            for sc_j = 0 to sc_i-1
                if array.get(sc_enabledPeriods, sc_j) and math.abs(sc_price-array.get(sc_periodPrices, sc_j)) < sc_proximity
                    sc_lane := math.max(sc_lane, array.get(sc_lanes, sc_j)+1)
        array.set(sc_lanes, sc_i, sc_lane)
        int sc_futureTime = sc_chartEnd + int(timeframe.in_seconds()*1000)*(sc_labelOffset + sc_lane*24)
        line sc_periodLine = array.get(sc_periodLines, sc_i)
        label sc_periodTag = array.get(sc_periodTags, sc_i)
        color sc_tint = array.get(sc_periodColors, sc_i)
        string sc_caption = array.get(sc_periodNames, sc_i)
        string sc_detail = sc_caption + " · previous completed " + (sc_i < 2 ? "trading day" : sc_i < 4 ? "week" : "month") + "\nFrom " + str.format_time(array.get(sc_sourceStarts, sc_i), "dd MMM yyyy", syminfo.timezone) + "\n" + str.tostring(sc_price, "#,###.##")
        if na(sc_periodLine)
            sc_periodLine := line.new(array.get(sc_periodStarts, sc_i), sc_price, sc_futureTime, sc_price, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=sc_tint, style=sc_i%2 == 0 ? line.style_dashed : line.style_dotted, force_overlay=true)
            sc_periodTag := label.new(bar_index + sc_labelOffset + sc_lane*24, sc_price, sc_caption, xloc=xloc.bar_index, style=label.style_label_left, color=sc_tint, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_detail, force_overlay=true)
            array.set(sc_periodLines, sc_i, sc_periodLine)
            array.set(sc_periodTags, sc_i, sc_periodTag)
        else
            line.set_xy1(sc_periodLine, array.get(sc_periodStarts, sc_i), sc_price)
            line.set_xy2(sc_periodLine, sc_futureTime, sc_price)
            label.set_xy(sc_periodTag, bar_index + sc_labelOffset + sc_lane*24, sc_price)
            label.set_tooltip(sc_periodTag, sc_detail)

// Exchange daily endpoints are frozen: 0% previous close, 100% current day open.
[sc_previousClose, sc_dailyOpen, sc_gapStart] = request.security(sc_requestTicker, "1D", [close[1], open, time], gaps=barmerge.gaps_off, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
var array<line> sc_gapLines = array.new<line>(5, na)
var array<label> sc_gapTags = array.new<label>(5, na)
var box sc_gapFill = na
if barstate.islast
    bool sc_hasGap = sc_showGap and not na(sc_previousClose) and not na(sc_dailyOpen) and math.abs(sc_dailyOpen-sc_previousClose) >= syminfo.mintick
    array<float> sc_gapRatios = array.from(0.0, 100.0, sc_p1, sc_p2, sc_p3)
    // Dedicated future columns keep the narrow gap Fib labels readable at true prices.
    for sc_i = 0 to 4
        line sc_gl = array.get(sc_gapLines, sc_i)
        label sc_gt = array.get(sc_gapTags, sc_i)
        if sc_hasGap
            float sc_ratio = array.get(sc_gapRatios, sc_i)
            float sc_price = sc_previousClose + (sc_dailyOpen-sc_previousClose)*sc_ratio/100
            int sc_labelBar = bar_index + sc_labelOffset + 48 + sc_i*10
            string sc_caption = sc_i == 0 ? "PDC" : sc_i == 1 ? "DO" : str.tostring(sc_ratio, "#.##") + "%"
            color sc_tint = sc_i < 2 ? sc_gapColor : sc_i == 2 ? sc_c1 : sc_i == 3 ? sc_c2 : sc_c3
            string sc_details = "Gap " + (sc_dailyOpen > sc_previousClose ? "up" : "down") + " · " + sc_caption + "\n" + str.tostring(sc_price, "#,###.##") + "\n0% previous trading-day close → 100% current exchange day open"
            if na(sc_gl)
                sc_gl := line.new(sc_gapStart, sc_price, sc_chartEnd, sc_price, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=sc_i < 2 ? color.new(sc_tint,20) : f_fibTint(sc_tint,sc_ratio/100), style=sc_i == 3 ? line.style_solid : line.style_dashed, width=sc_i == 3 ? 2 : 1, force_overlay=true)
                sc_gt := label.new(sc_labelBar, sc_price, sc_caption, xloc=xloc.bar_index, style=label.style_label_left, color=sc_tint, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny, tooltip=sc_details, force_overlay=true)
                array.set(sc_gapLines, sc_i, sc_gl)
                array.set(sc_gapTags, sc_i, sc_gt)
            else
                line.set_xy1(sc_gl, sc_gapStart, sc_price)
                line.set_xy2(sc_gl, sc_chartEnd, sc_price)
                label.set_xy(sc_gt, sc_labelBar, sc_price)
                label.set_text(sc_gt, sc_caption)
                label.set_tooltip(sc_gt, sc_details)
        else
            line.delete(sc_gl)
            label.delete(sc_gt)
            array.set(sc_gapLines, sc_i, na)
            array.set(sc_gapTags, sc_i, na)
    if not na(sc_gapFill)
        box.delete(sc_gapFill)
        sc_gapFill := na
    if sc_hasGap

        if array.size(records) > 0
            for i = array.size(records)-1 to 0
                RZRecord z = array.get(records,i)
                if time_close[1]-z.origin > rzDays*86400000
                    array.remove(records,i)
                else if z.state != 2 and (not rzFreeze or z.state == 0) and time_close[1] > z.born
                    bool invalid = z.side == 1 ? close[1] < z.lo : close[1] > z.hi
                    bool touched = close[1] >= z.lo and close[1] <= z.hi
                    if invalid
                        z.state := 2
                        if not rzFreeze or z.tests == 0
                            z.finish := time_close[1]
                        z.touching := false
                    else
                        if touched and not z.touching
                            z.tests += 1
                            z.state := 1
                            if rzFreeze and z.tests == 1
                                z.finish := time_close[1]
                        z.touching := touched
                        if not rzFreeze or z.tests == 0
                            z.finish := time_close[1]
        if not na(ph[1])
            swingHigh := ph[1]
            highBroken := false
        if not na(pl[1])
            swingLow := pl[1]
            lowBroken := false
        bool breakUp = not na(swingHigh) and not highBroken and close[1] > swingHigh
        bool breakDown = not na(swingLow) and not lowBroken and close[1] < swingLow

        if breakUp
            highBroken := true
        if breakDown

                float lo = low[offset]

                        duplicate := true

                    if side == 1
                        lastUp := bar_index-1
                    else
                        lastDown := bar_index-1

int spRtAutoLength = input.int(5, "ATR length", minval=1, group=spRtGroup, display=display.none)
int spRtStLength = spRtAutoLength
float spRtFactor = input.float(3.0, "Base factor", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=spRtGroup, display=display.none)
string spRtBrickMode = input.string("Auto", "Brick size mode", options=["Auto", "Manual"], group=spRtGroup, display=display.none)
float spRtManualBrick = input.float(12.8, "Manual brick size", minval=0.00000001, active=spRtBrickMode == "Manual", group=spRtGroup, display=display.none)
bool spRtShowMidline = input.bool(true, "Show Market Min Midline", group=spRtGroup, tooltip="Gaussian midline using the Sector Pulse dashboard period.", display=display.none)

var float spRtHostAtr = na
spRtHostAtr := ta.atr(spRtAutoLength)
float spRtRegimeAtr = ta.atr(15)
float spRtLowAtr = ta.atr(9)
float spRtVolatilityRatio = spRtRegimeAtr > 0 ? spRtHostAtr / spRtRegimeAtr : 1.0
float spRtEffectiveFactor = spRtFactor + (spRtVolatilityRatio > 1.2 ? 1.0 : spRtVolatilityRatio < 0.8 ? -0.5 : 0.0)
float spRtAutoBox = math.max(syminfo.mintick, spRtVolatilityRatio > 1.2 ? spRtHostAtr * 1.5 : spRtVolatilityRatio < 0.8 ? spRtLowAtr * 0.7 : spRtHostAtr)
float spRtBox = spRtBrickMode == "Manual" ? spRtManualBrick : spRtAutoBox
var float spRtRc = na
var float spRtRo = na
var float spRtSyntheticAtr = na
var float spRtUpper = na
var float spRtLower = na
var float spRtSt = na
var int spRtDirection = 1
if na(spRtRc)
    spRtRc := close
    spRtRo := close
float spRtPreviousRc = spRtRc
float spRtDelta = close - spRtRc
int spRtSteps = spRtBox > 0 ? int(math.floor(math.abs(spRtDelta) / spRtBox)) : 0
if spRtSteps >= 1
    spRtRo := spRtRc
    spRtRc += math.sign(spRtDelta) * spRtSteps * spRtBox
float spRtRh = math.max(spRtRo, spRtRc)
float spRtRl = math.min(spRtRo, spRtRc)
float spRtSyntheticTr = math.max(spRtRh - spRtRl, math.max(math.abs(spRtRh - spRtPreviousRc), math.abs(spRtRl - spRtPreviousRc)))
spRtSyntheticAtr := na(spRtSyntheticAtr) ? spRtSyntheticTr : spRtSyntheticAtr + (spRtSyntheticTr - spRtSyntheticAtr) / spRtStLength
float spRtMidpoint = (spRtRh + spRtRl) / 2
float spRtBasicUpper = spRtMidpoint + spRtEffectiveFactor * spRtSyntheticAtr
float spRtBasicLower = spRtMidpoint - spRtEffectiveFactor * spRtSyntheticAtr
float spRtPreviousUpper = spRtUpper
float spRtPreviousLower = spRtLower
float spRtPreviousSt = spRtSt
spRtUpper := na(spRtPreviousUpper) or spRtBasicUpper < spRtPreviousUpper or spRtPreviousRc > spRtPreviousUpper ? spRtBasicUpper : spRtPreviousUpper
spRtLower := na(spRtPreviousLower) or spRtBasicLower > spRtPreviousLower or spRtPreviousRc < spRtPreviousLower ? spRtBasicLower : spRtPreviousLower
if na(spRtPreviousSt)
    spRtDirection := 1
else if spRtPreviousSt == spRtPreviousUpper
    spRtDirection := spRtRc > spRtUpper ? -1 : 1
else
    spRtDirection := spRtRc < spRtLower ? 1 : -1
spRtSt := spRtDirection < 0 ? spRtLower : spRtUpper
bool spRtSupported = chart.is_standard or chart.is_renko
plot(spRtShow and spRtSupported ? spRtSt : na, "AI Supertrend", color=spRtDirection < 0 ? color.rgb(46, 160, 67) : color.rgb(229, 57, 53), linewidth=2, display=display.pane + display.data_window, force_overlay=true)
// Midline trend follows its slope; flat bars retain the last established direction.
var int spRtMidlineTrend = 0
spRtMidlineTrend := inferredDirection != 0 ? inferredDirection : nz(spRtMidlineTrend[1],0)
color spRtMidlineColor = spRtMidlineTrend > 0 ? color.rgb(46,160,67) : spRtMidlineTrend < 0 ? color.rgb(229,57,53) : color.rgb(255,184,77)
plot(spRtShowMidline ? inferredG3 : na, "Market Min Midline", color=spRtMidlineColor, linewidth=2, display=display.pane + display.data_window, force_overlay=true)

//=============================================================================
// DIVERGENCE
//=============================================================================

rzRsi_lookbackRight = 5
rzRsi_lookbackLeft = 5
rzRsi_rangeUpper = 60
rzRsi_rangeLower = 5

rzRsi_bearColor = color.red
rzRsi_bullColor = color.green
rzRsi_textColor = color.white
rzRsi_noneColor = color.new(color.white, 100)

rzRsi__inRange(bool rzRsi_cond) =>
    rzRsi_bars = ta.barssince(rzRsi_cond)
    rzRsi_rangeLower <= rzRsi_bars and rzRsi_bars <= rzRsi_rangeUpper

rzRsi_plFound = false
rzRsi_phFound = false

rzRsi_bullCond = false
rzRsi_bearCond = false

rzRsi_rsiLBR = rzRsi_rsi[rzRsi_lookbackRight]

if rzRsi_calculateDivergence
    // Regular Bullish
    rzRsi_plFound := not na(ta.pivotlow(rzRsi_rsi, rzRsi_lookbackLeft, rzRsi_lookbackRight))

    rzRsi_rsiHL = rzRsi_rsiLBR > ta.valuewhen(rzRsi_plFound, rzRsi_rsiLBR, 1) and rzRsi__inRange(rzRsi_plFound[1])

    rzRsi_lowLBR = low[rzRsi_lookbackRight]
    rzRsi_priceLL = rzRsi_lowLBR < ta.valuewhen(rzRsi_plFound, rzRsi_lowLBR, 1)

    rzRsi_bullCond := rzRsi_priceLL and rzRsi_rsiHL and rzRsi_plFound

    // Regular Bearish
    rzRsi_phFound := not na(ta.pivothigh(rzRsi_rsi, rzRsi_lookbackLeft, rzRsi_lookbackRight))

    rzRsi_rsiLH = rzRsi_rsiLBR < ta.valuewhen(rzRsi_phFound, rzRsi_rsiLBR, 1) and rzRsi__inRange(rzRsi_phFound[1])

    rzRsi_highLBR = high[rzRsi_lookbackRight]
    rzRsi_priceHH = rzRsi_highLBR > ta.valuewhen(rzRsi_phFound, rzRsi_highLBR, 1)

    rzRsi_bearCond := rzRsi_priceHH and rzRsi_rsiLH and rzRsi_phFound

//=============================================================================
// DIVERGENCE PLOTS
//=============================================================================

plot(
     rzRsi_plFound ? rzRsi_rsiLBR : na,
     offset=-rzRsi_lookbackRight,
     title="Regular Bullish",
     linewidth=2,
     color=rzRsi_bullCond ? rzRsi_bullColor : rzRsi_noneColor,
     display=display.pane,
     editable=rzRsi_calculateDivergence
)

plotshape(
     rzRsi_bullCond ? rzRsi_rsiLBR : na,
     offset=-rzRsi_lookbackRight,
     title="Regular Bullish Label",
     text="Bull",
     style=shape.labelup,
     location=location.absolute,
     color=rzRsi_bullColor,
     textcolor=rzRsi_textColor,
     display=display.pane,
     editable=rzRsi_calculateDivergence
)

plot(
     rzRsi_phFound ? rzRsi_rsiLBR : na,
     offset=-rzRsi_lookbackRight,
     title="Regular Bearish",
     linewidth=2,
     color=rzRsi_bearCond ? rzRsi_bearColor : rzRsi_noneColor,
     display=display.pane,
     editable=rzRsi_calculateDivergence
)

plotshape(
     rzRsi_bearCond ? rzRsi_rsiLBR : na,
     offset=-rzRsi_lookbackRight,
     title="Regular Bearish Label",
     text="Bear",
     style=shape.labeldown,
     location=location.absolute,
     color=rzRsi_bearColor,
     textcolor=rzRsi_textColor,
     display=display.pane,
     editable=rzRsi_calculateDivergence
)
